title: Trace SQLite transaction result and error propagation

findings.claim: sql.ts only builds IN (...) placeholders. The transaction wrapper on this runtime is bun:sqlite Database.transaction (Bun 1.3.14 wrapTransaction).
findings.evidence: static read of sql.ts; bun sqlite.ts wrapTransaction fetched 2026-09-06 from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oven-sh/bun/bun-v1.3.14/src/js/bun/sqlite.ts (HTTP 200)

findings.claim: Inner db.transaction(fn).immediate() does not run BEGIN IMMEDIATE when db.inTransaction is already true. It runs SAVEPOINT / RELEASE (or ROLLBACK TO then RELEASE on throw). Outer ROLLBACK still undoes released savepoint work.
findings.evidence: Bun 1.3.14 wrapTransaction; existing static case packages/core/test/event-causal-origin.test.ts:81-90; stub call-order PASS

findings.claim: accept() converts EventRecordError/EventOriginError to {status:error, kind:infrastructure} and other throws to kind:validation after the inner wrapper has rolled back. processEvent rethrows infrastructure (outer ROLLBACK) and returns validation errors (outer COMMIT of an empty event). Returning a result never aborts an enclosing bun transaction.
findings.evidence: static source; stub processEventLike tests PASS; no existing core test records this call-order

findings.location: staging/proposals.ts:662 (default BEGIN) vs ledger write paths (.immediate())
findings.claim: Top-level staging uses default BEGIN rather than BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Nested under processEvent this is a savepoint so the flavor is ignored. Not treated as a defect in this packet.
